prompt: Repair `version_recommendation` in `src/solution.py`. Return `(recommendation, basis, uncertainty)`. Exact-version official documentation yields `use` when supported or `avoid` when unsupported, with basis `documented` and uncertainty `none`. A version mismatch yields `verify-first`, `version-mismatch`, `current applicability unknown`. Any non-official source yields `verify-first`, `secondary-source`, `primary confirmation needed`. Preserve the public signature, change only this function in `src/solution.py`, and run the visible suite.
title: Version-sensitive recommendation
